jobs.description:
Vi vil løbende gennemgå ansøgninger, så vent ikke med at søge.

Om stillingen

Som student hos Danske Commodities får du en unik mulighed for at blive en del af et dynamisk team, der arbejder med analyse og optimering af intraday-handel på energimarkedet. Du vil få indsigt i de komplekse mekanismer, der driver markedet, og bidrage til at sikre en effektiv og stabil drift.

Om dig

Du er studerende inden for økonomi, finans, ingeniørvidenskab eller et andet relevant fagområde. Du har et stort analytisk talent og en naturlig nysgerrighed for data og markedsdynamik. Det er vigtigt, at du er struktureret, præcis og i stand til at arbejde selvstændigt, men også trives i et samarbejde med kolleger. Erfaring med Excel eller andre dataanalyseværktøjer er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

• Et spændende studiejob i en international virksomhed med fokus på bæredygtighed og innovation.

• Mulighed for at lære om energimarkeder og intraday-handel fra en erfaren faglig gruppe.

• Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling.

• Fleksible arbejdstider, der passer ind i din studieplan.

Ansøgning

Har du lyst til at blive en del af teamet? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV til Christoffer Brødsgaard Kastberg, Head of Intraday Analysis, via linket nedenfor. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Ansøg her

Om Danske Commodities

Danske Commodities er en del af Danske Bank Group og er en førende aktør på det nordiske energimarked. Vi specialiserer os i handel, analyse og risikostyring inden for el, naturgas og CO2. Vores mission er at skabe værdi for vores kunder og bidrage til en mere bæredygtig energifremtid gennem intelligent handel og analyse. Vi har kontorer i flere lande og en stærk tilstedeværelse i Norden.

jobs.occupation: Senior Regulatory Data Professional - Structured Content (Docuvera) - Fixed-term contract
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**Help shape how structured regulatory content is created, managed and used across a global organisation. As our Senior Regulatory Data Professional (****Fixed-term contract for 12 months), you will strengthen data quality, improve the way colleagues work in Docuvera and support the development of faster, more efficient global submissions. Your expertise will help create a reliable digital foundation for regulatory writing and label development.

**What You’ll Bring

**You combine knowledge of structured content with strong analytical skills and a practical understanding of how digital tools support regulatory work. You communicate complex topics clearly and can bring stakeholders together around effective, sustainable solutions.

**We Are Looking For Someone With

**

• Hands-on experience with structured content authoring and associated tools in a pharmaceutical environment. Experience with Docuvera would be particularly relevant.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate data-quality issues and turn findings into workable solutions.

• The ability to communicate technical or process-related topics clearly and succinctly to different audiences.

• A good understanding of business needs, combined with strong digital capabilities.

• A collaborative, proactive and structured approach to working with stakeholders across functions and geographies.

• Experience with label text and label management, which would be an advantage rather than an essential requirement.

**What You’ll Do

**In this role, you will become a subject-matter expert for structured content processes and help colleagues use Docuvera effectively. You will:

• Develop, maintain and continuously improve structured content functionality and processes in Docuvera.

• Translate business needs into clear requirements and support testing, documentation and implementation activities.

• Analyse and resolve regulatory data challenges while helping maintain alignment with relevant external standards.

• Use data insights to identify improvement opportunities and support better business and regulatory outcomes.

• Lead or contribute to process-optimisation initiatives across Regulatory Scientific Writing and related functional areas.

• Support adoption through stakeholder engagement, user-focused communication, training, change support and the sharing of best practices.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the newly established Label Writing and Management team within Regulatory Scientific Writing. The team develops and supports the regulatory data, systems and processes used in label development across Novo Nordisk.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Research and Development, and affiliates worldwide. You can expect a highly cross-functional environment where regulatory knowledge, digital expertise and user needs come together. You will have the opportunity to influence how new ways of working are designed and adopted across global teams.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to shape an evolving area of regulatory work and contribute to solutions that can improve both quality and efficiency. You will work in a global environment where curiosity, clear thinking and constructive collaboration are valued.

At Novo Nordisk, opportunities to learn and develop are part of the experience, while employee benefits are designed with different career and life stages in mind.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen structured regulatory content and help build smarter global submission processes, apply for the Senior Regulatory Data Professional – Structured Content (Docuvera) role by 15 November 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Build with us

**Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

**Your impact

**This is your chance to build Mollie's presence in Denmark from the ground up, as the first person hired with this market as your sole focus. You won't be starting from zero: you'll have the Nordic foundation already built in Sweden to work from, but the Danish playbook is yours to write.

You'll open the market, land our first Danish customers, and turn early learnings into a repeatable approach we can scale. It's a broader, more entrepreneurial scope than a standard sales role. You'll work deals from $100K a month while building toward bigger opportunities of up to $1 million a month, all while shaping how Mollie understands and enters this market for the long run.

What makes this role stand out is the mix: outbound selling, customer discovery, partnerships, and competitive analysis, all rolled into one seat with real ownership. If you want to build something rather than maintain something, this is that opportunity.

**What You'll Ship

**

• Run outbound sales and manage the full sales process, including around 20 cold calls a week

• Build a Danish pipeline and land Mollie's first customers in the market

• Gather market feedback and grow larger opportunities, including deals of up to $1 million a month

• Build relationships with Danish agencies and work on partnerships alongside the partner manager based in Stockholm

• Share what you learn about the Danish marketing landscape with the marketing team to help shape events and go-to-market plans

• Run competitive analysis to sharpen how Mollie positions itself in Denmark

**What You'll Bring

**

• Around 5 years of full-cycle sales experience, with a strong outbound track record and demonstrated success in structured cold outreach

• Value selling capability, with a data-driven approach to activity and pipeline management

• Strong negotiation and contract handling skills, including experience communicating and negotiating with C-level stakeholders

• Creativity in building a pipeline through partnerships or marketing outreach (you don't need to have done this before, just show the potential)

• Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS sales, built across multiple companies

• Comfortable working hands-on in a role with broad scope and real uncertainty

• Fluency in Danish

**Grow your way

**At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

**AI at Mollie

**We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

Join us in this role where you’ll originate and build new ventures from the ground up, turning bold ideas into scalable businesses. You’ll shape opportunities, validate them with the market, and drive early commercialisation, working across functions and leveraging the strength of a global organisation.

**Welcome to Ventures & Open Innovation

**You’ll be part of a team focused on identifying and scaling transformational opportunities, where you together with your colleagues will explore new markets, business models, and technologies. You’ll collaborate closely across engineering, commercial, and business development functions to bring new ideas to life. As a team, we support each other, challenge ideas constructively, and work with curiosity and ownership to turn ambition into impact.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• originating new business opportunities by identifying white spaces and shaping opportunity areas

• leading end-to-end venture building from ideation through validation to early commercialisation

• designing and testing business models through structured experimentation and rapid learning

• collaborating with internal stakeholders to unlock capabilities and move opportunities forward

• translating technical assets and capabilities into new commercial propositions

• contributing to innovation strategy and portfolio prioritisation.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have hands-on experience building new businesses or ventures from concept to launch

• bring a strong commercial mindset, focusing on customers, value creation, and revenue models

• are comfortable working across ambiguity and can create structure and direction independently

• collaborate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, or equivalent experience

• demonstrate curiosity and quickly build understanding in new industries or domains

• communicate clearly and persuasively, building alignment around new ideas.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr62,160.00- kr93,240.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Senior Manager in Partnerships

The Danish and Icelandic Affiliate | Novo

Are you passionate about building partnerships that can shape the future of healthcare? Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to turn emerging opportunities into sustainable solutions for patients and the business?

We are looking for a Senior Manager in Partnerships to join the Danish and Icelandic Affiliate to help identify, develop and drive business growth through strategic partnerships.

In this exciting position you will build strong collaboration with eHealth providers and healthcare partners supporting our ambitions for patients and our business.

What you’ll bring

• An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) in Business Administration, Project Management or a related field.

• At least 5 years of experience in strategic partnerships, external stakeholder management, commercial strategy or consulting.

• Experience managing teams and developing talent, including setting objectives, coaching and managing performance.

• Solid business development and key account management experience and a proven track record of developing, negotiating and managing strategic partnerships and alliances.

• A strong understanding of the healthcare ecosystem and the trends and challenges shaping the industry.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex information into actionable insights.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English, written and spoken.

What you’ll do

As Senior Manager, Partnerships, you will identify, develop, and maintain strategic partnerships opportunities aligned with Novo's strategic priorities.

A key part of your role will be exploring what comes next. You will identify changes in the healthcare environment, assess emerging opportunities and help translate them into new partnerships, patient solutions and commercial approaches.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Identify and develop strategic partnerships and new business opportunities, from market insight and initial dialogue through implementation and ongoing relationship management.

• Analyse market developments and identifying opportunities for growth across our existing and future portfolio.

• Build new collaborations, ecosystems and commercial solutions that respond to changes in the healthcare environment and support sustainable business growth.

• Drive performance management through clear objectives, KPIs and regular reviews to ensure ROI and make timely decisions on when to scale, adapt or stop initiatives.

• Lead the Key Account Managers in driving performance with e-Health providers and pharmacies within obesity and diabetes through territory planning, customer segmentation and coordinated, compliant customer engagement.

• Develop patient solutions that improve patient access, education and adherence in collaboration with the marketing team.

• Drive cross-functional execution and translate partnership performance into recommendations, working closely with Commercial, Communication, Sales, MAPA and Medical and providing relevant insights to Leadership Teams.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Partnerships team in the Danish and Icelandic Affiliate and report to the Director, Sales & Partnerships. You will lead a team of five, including Strategic Partnerships Managers, an Associate Alliance Manager and Key Account Managers, covering Denmark. You will collaborate with colleagues across Commercial, Sales, MAPA, Medical and Leadership Teams, setting the strategic direction and supporting the implementation.

Externally, your stakeholder landscape will depend on the opportunities you pursue and include, eHealth providers, private hospitals, private specialists insurance companies and other relevant healthcare and industry partners.

We are looking for a person who is comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments, creating connections and bringing different perspectives together around shared opportunities. Where others see obstacles, you see opportunities.

What you can expect here

At Novo, we work to drive change to defeat serious chronic diseases. Achieving that ambition increasingly requires us to look beyond traditional ways of working and collaborate across the healthcare ecosystem.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to explore new possibilities, build strategic partnerships and help develop innovative approaches that connect patient needs, healthcare transformation and sustainable business opportunities.

If you are motivated by creating something new, bringing partners together and turning opportunities into solutions that can make a difference for patients, we would like to hear from you.

**What We Offer

**At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,560.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Apply now and join us in shaping new partnerships and opportunities for the future of healthcare

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build partnerships that turn patient and customer needs into measurable progress in Denmark, apply for the Sr. Manager, Partnerships role by 18 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product to atNorth, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
atNorth is the leading Nordic data center company specializing in scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit facilities that meet the unique needs of today’s AI and high performance workloads. With more than 15 years of proven expertise, atNorth delivers secure, flexible and sustainable infrastructure, powered entirely by renewable energy and benefitting from advanced cooling technologies, including several Direct Liquid Cooling and Direct to Chip installations. By combining operational excellence and a commitment to environmental responsibility with trusted customer relationships that enable rapid scalability, atNorth empowers businesses to grow while minimizing their environmental impact. Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across strategic Nordic locations, with a site to open in Ballerup, Denmark in 2025, as well as its tenth under construction in Kouvola, Finland and its eleventh site in Varde Municipality, Denmark. The business has also secured land for a future mega site in the Sollefteå Municipality in Sweden. For more information, visit atNorth.com or follow atNorth on LinkedIn.

Are you a senior leader passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and translating customer needs into meaningful product and service improvements? Do you have the strategic mindset and leadership skills to connect customer insight, commercial priorities and operational realities?

atNorth is looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product to lead the Customer Experience & Product function within Customer Operations. In this role, you will shape the customer experience strategy, drive customer journey excellence and oversee product, service catalogue and customer-facing platform priorities across an international and fast-growing digital infrastructure organization.

The Role

As Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product, you will own the frameworks, standards and priorities that ensure a clear, scalable and consistent customer experience across atNorth. You will translate customer insight, business objectives and operational needs into clear priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

The role combines customer experience strategy, product and service management, digital platform development and leadership. You will work closely with Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance to ensure that customer needs are reflected in how atNorth develops its services, processes and digital capabilities.

Key responsibilities include:

• Define and lead the Customer Experience & Product strategy, operating framework, standards and governance routines.

• Translate business objectives, customer insight and operational needs into priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

• Own the end-to-end customer journey framework and standards for customer interactions throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Govern customer feedback and satisfaction insights, ensuring that customer insight is translated into tangible improvements.

• Set standards for customer onboarding, communication, enablement, knowledge and self-service experiences.

• Own Customer Operations governance of the service catalogue, customer-facing service definitions and product/service lifecycle input.

• Define and prioritize customer-facing requirements for the portal, CRM, Jira and other digital and self-service capabilities.

• Ensure customer needs, commercial priorities and operational realities are reflected in product, service and platform roadmaps.

• Lead and develop the Product Manager and Customer Experience Manager, setting direction, priorities, performance expectations and development goals

• Represent customer experience and product priorities in management, governance and roadmap forums.

• Drive cross-functional priorities by aligning stakeholders across Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance.

• Monitor progress against Customer Experience & Product OKRs, strategic priorities and improvement roadmaps, identifying risks and driving timely decisions.

You will also have the authority to set functional priorities, allocate work across Product Management and Customer Experience, and prioritize customer-facing product, service, process and platform improvements within agreed strategy, budget and governance boundaries.

atNorth is an international and fast-growing company where collaboration, ownership and continuous improvement are central to the culture. In this role, you will have broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to shape how customers experience atNorth – from onboarding and communication to services, products and digital platforms.

Is this you?

We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader who combines a strong customer focus with strategic thinking, product understanding and the ability to turn insight into action. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and bringing different stakeholders together around a common customer and business agenda.

You have:

• 8–10+ years of experience within customer experience, customer success, product or service management, service delivery or related fields.

• Experience from data center, IT infrastructure, B2B technology or another complex service environment.

• Proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and empower high-performing teams.

• Strong understanding of customer experience strategy, customer journeys and service design.

• Experience with product and service portfolio management and/or service catalogue governance.

• The ability to translate customer, commercial and operational insight into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Experience managing customer-facing digital platforms, requirements or self-service capabilities.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

• Excellent communication, facilitation and executive-level reporting skills.

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Product Management, Service Management, IT, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish is preferred.

As a person, you are strategic, customer-focused and decisive, with a strong ability to create clarity in complex environments. You are a natural collaborator who can build relationships across functions while confidently challenging existing ways of working when needed. You combine commercial awareness with an analytical and pragmatic approach and are motivated by creating measurable improvements in both customer experience and business performance.

Experience or certification in ITIL, product management, service design or customer experience is considered an advantage.

Do you want to know more?

In this process atNorth is working with Level Recruitment. To apply, please click the apply button. If you have further questions don´t hesitate to contact senior recruitment consultant Christian Smith at +46 8 120 50 400.

We will interview ongoingly so please register your application as soon as possible.

Location: Central Copenhagen; primarily in office

Language: English

**Highlights

**

• Full-Stack Python/TS engineer needed for a B2B SaaS startup in Copenhagen (with plenty of traction!)

• We have a lean, get-stuff-done team. No annoying extra management layers or unnecessary bureaucratic rituals. And we are "AI-forward" in our own development practices.

• You will own features end to end, from the data model through to the screen, on a platform that manufacturers rely on to keep production lines running.

• You will work in a small engineering team, directly with the person who decides what we build, and the problems you spend your time on are hard because the domain is hard, not because the organization is.

• We're building legitimately useful tools for the industries and companies that make the world go around.... manufacturers. Both AI-tools and just "plain-old-good-software" tools.

**About Supplios

**Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality, all in a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth.

The platform now covers more ground than the team that built it. We are hiring engineers to keep that pace sustainable, and to go deeper on the parts of the product our customers are pushing hardest.

The role

You will join a small engineering team and work across the whole stack: Python on the backend, TypeScript on the frontend and in the AI layers. There is no split between people who design and people who implement. You will take a problem from a customer conversation or a product decision through to something running in production for real manufacturers.

You will work directly with our co-founder and CEO, who is a hands-on product builder himself. That means short conversations instead of tickets thrown over a wall, and it means your questions about why something should work a certain way get answered by the person who decided it.

The domain is genuinely complicated, and that is the interesting part. Supplier relationships in automotive involve deep hierarchies, long-running approval processes, strict audit requirements and a lot of state that has to be exactly right. Modeling that well is most of the job.

Title and level flex with experience. We are open to strong mid-level engineers and to senior engineers who want more scope than their current company gives them.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and on a codebase with this much implicit context, working through problems with the rest of the team in person is much faster than doing it in writing. Sensible flexibility when you need it is a given; full-time remote is not what we are offering.

**Our Current Stack

**

• Backend: Python / Django

• Frontend: Vue (but no specific Vue experience is needed)

• Infrastructure: AWS (mostly)

• Agents: Cloudflare (TypeScript) + Claude & OpenAI platform

What you will do

• Build features end to end, from data model and backend logic through to the TypeScript frontend our customers actually click on.

• Build end-to-end / front-to-back AI features (in-app AI assistants, background worker agents, email-routing agents, customer-configurable agent framework components)

• Design and evolve the relational data model that sits under supplier relationships, approvals and quality records.

• Take vaguely defined customer problems and turn them into something specific enough to build, then build it.

• Work on integrations between Supplios and customer systems (ERP and adjacent tooling), where failures have visible consequences for a production line.

• Improve the parts of the codebase that need it, rather than routing around them.

• Review other people's code and have yours reviewed; we keep the loop tight and unbureaucratic.

• Help keep the platform healthy in production across our regions: errors, performance and the boring things that keep customers trusting us.

• Take part in product decisions. Engineers here are expected to have opinions about what we build, not just how.

What we are looking for

**Essential

**

• Professional experience with Python. This is not negotiable; the backend is Python and you need to be effective in it.

• Solid TypeScript experience and genuine comfort working on the frontend.

• Experience building and running SaaS products, including the part after launch where real users depend on them.

• AI-forward development techniques. (This does not mean you no longer write code.)

• A track record of owning work end to end without waiting to be told what to do next.

• The temperament for a small, senior company: high ownership, low ceremony.

• You want to work primarily from an office in central Copenhagen, with a small team.

**Nice to have

**Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. Nobody has all of these.

• Experience with B2B enterprise SaaS, especially where customers are large and demanding and implementations are not self-serve. This is a significant plus.

• Experience with complex relational data modeling, and with large, long-lived codebases that you did not write yourself. A big plus.

• Experience building AI-based products, using the latest frameworks/harnesses and infrastructure components (including RAG) is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with any of: domain-driven design, the actor model, finite state machines, CQRS, event-driven architecture. We use these ideas where they earn their place, and it helps if the vocabulary is already yours.

• Startup experience, particularly early stage. A significant plus.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

**Language

**English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

jobs.occupation: Project & People Manager, Defence Services, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Ready to lead software deployment, training and technical support projects for Defence customers, develop your team and shape a growing department? Combine hands-on project delivery with direct people management, bringing mission-critical software to military customers across the Nordics.

**The job

**As Project & People Manager in our Nordic Constellation, you will manage and lead multiple customer projects simultaneously. These projects involve deploying our SitaWare and Iris product suites into customers’ organisations, delivering training services, providing technical support for military exercises and helping customers get the most from our products.

Alongside responsibility for the delivery and implementation of our Defence product suites at our customers, you will:

• Ensure delivery to the agreed scope, schedule and quality standards while maintaining and developing long-term customer relationships.

• Work closely with our business development team to expand customer engagement in new and established markets by shaping and scoping solutions, preparing estimates and writing commercial proposals.

• Take direct people and line management responsibility, including recruitment, employee development and retention.

• Together with your team, foster an engaging workplace where people enjoy coming to work.

You will on a regular basis travel to customer locations in the Nordic countries, most predominantly in the Capitol Region in Denmark.

**Joining the team

**Join Defence Services, Nordic, and help customers in Denmark and across Scandinavia bring our SitaWare solutions into their organisations. In Copenhagen, you will join a Defence Services team of around 10 people, including fellow managers, solution architects, solution engineers and student workers. As our department grows, you will have the opportunity to help shape how we work and strengthen our leadership team. Reporting to the Senior Director for the Nordic Constellation, you will collaborate with fellow managers and colleagues across constellations, combining hands-on project delivery with people management.

**What You Will Bring

**You bring solid experience leading software or IT projects using agile methods and enjoy combining project delivery with managing and developing employees. You take ownership and are ready to grow your responsibilities as you deliver results.

We are also looking for:

• A relevant degree in IT, software or a related field, preferably at master’s level.

• Direct line management experience with formal responsibility for employees, including coaching, motivation and development, along with the ability to influence people both within and outside the organisation.

• Experience working directly with customers and other stakeholders - experience in defence or a similar industry is a clear advantage.

• Fluency in spoken and written English.

• Project management certification, such as PMI, PRINCE2 or IPMA Level B/C, and Scrum or ITIL certification backed by practical experience - these are an advantage, but not a requirement.

• A decisive, results-driven mindset combined with an analytical, structured approach, and the ability to engage customers, end-users, senior management and your team to deliver projects within budget, on schedule and to the required quality standards.

• A collaborative colleague who contributes to both achieving results and fostering a positive team culture.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

**Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

**When you join us in Copenhagen, you’re not just getting a desk at one of the city’s best locations - you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

**Never stop developing

**Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1300 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

**Start your development here

**We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Mikkel Lykke Predstrup, Senior Director, Defence Services.

jobs.occupation: HSO International - Microsoft D365 Project Manager
jobs.description:
HSO International – Project Manager

Position: Project Manager

Department: Program Services

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in your country of residence within the EMEA region. Sponsorship and relocation only available within the Netherlands

Type of work: Remote or Hybrid, depending on location

International travel is required depending on program needs. **Minimun 35% travelling

****About The Role

**The Project Manager at HSO is accountable for the successful delivery of a defined project or major workstream within a broader transformation program. This role owns delivery outcomes within clear boundaries: scope, schedule, quality, readiness, and customer adoption for their project.

In this role, your primary focus is on driving execution excellence. You spend most of your time on detailed planning, sequencing, dependency management, readiness control (testing, data, cutover), issue resolution, and day-to-day delivery leadership. You optimize outcomes within given constraints and ensure that delivery reality is visible early.

If you want a role where you own the execution layer of large or complex global programs and make a direct impact on delivery success, this is it.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own day-to-day delivery of assigned projects or complex program workstreams, ensuring scope, plan, dependencies, and customer readiness remain aligned

• Participate in pre-sales and mobilization by shaping delivery plans, budgets, governance models, and risk assumptions that are executable in practice

• Contribute to and co-author Statements of Work (SOW), with specific accountability for assumptions, risks, delivery economics, team structures, phase entry/exit criteria, and change control

• Build and maintain integrated delivery plans that align architecture, build, testing, integrations, and customer activities

• Coordinate cross-functional delivery across architects, developers, functional consultants, testers, integration teams, and customer SMEs

• Monitor requirements gathering and setting acceptance criteria, ensure backlog items are sized, prioritized, and ready for build

• Drive testing readiness, including test planning, data availability, environment coordination, defect management, and go-live preparation

• Maintain strong RAID discipline, proactively identifying risks, issues, dependencies, and downstream impacts

• Identify scope gaps early and initiate structured change-control discussions when required

• Run governance forums that drive real decisions, including steering committees, risk reviews, and change control boards

• Communicate clear, factual status and risk updates to customers, senior project managers, and program leadership

• Partner with customers to strengthen their ability to participate effectively in requirements, testing, data readiness, and decision-making

• Contribute to continuous improvement of HSO’s Standard Working Practices (SWP) and delivery quality culture

• Depending on seniority and complexity of an assigned project, you will work under the guidance and direction of a Senior Project Manager or Program Manager.

**Requirements

**

• 3–5+ year’s experience delivering ERP. Data, or digital transformation projects experience is preferable into ERP Implementation experience

• Must exposure to Dynamics 365 ERP experience or comparable enterprise platforms

• Experience in complex, multi-team or multi-stakeholder environments

• Strong grounding in planning, backlog management, requirements clarification, testing preparation, and RAID (Risks, Actions, Issues, and Decisions)

• Experience working within structured delivery frameworks and governance models

• Ability to see and manage task-level delays and manage their downstream impacts

• Ability to simplify complexity and drive clarity in pressured environments

• Experience using DevOps or similar delivery management tools.

• Hands-on, structured, and proactive approach to execution and problem solving.

• Confidence to escalate issues factually and early

• Influence without authority; create clarity and accountability through facts, options, and trade-offs

• Structured approach to risk management, ambiguity, and scenario-based decision-making

• Awareness of delivery economics and commercial impact

• Ability to balance scope, quality, time, and cost without false certainty

• International travel required depending on program needs. Minimun 35% travelling

**Benefits

****Why should you choose HSO International?

****_Development and growth

_**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and a distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents, and ambitions.

**Career Path for this role

****HSO Offers a Clear, Capability-based Progression For Delivery Professionals

**Project Coordinator / PMO → Project Manager → Senior Project Manager → Program Manager.

Project Managers grow by mastering execution discipline, customer leadership, and cross-team coordination within global transformation programs.

**_Fun and success

_**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

**_International project exposure

_**Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

**_Freedom and responsibility

_**You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

**Take the next step!

**Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

**Job Description

**_Would you like to use your property management experience to help develop solutions that create real value? As a Property Manager at Netcompany, you will work with technical teams and customers to turn real-life experience into solutions that improve property management through a data driven approach that ensure the right usage of AI and digital capabilities.

_**Responsibilities

**Netcompany is looking for a Property Manager to take a key role in the continued development of our property management solutions. The role is for an experienced, operational property manager who knows the reality of managing properties day to day and can use that experience to help shape better digital solutions. You will bring hands-on knowledge of property management into the product development process and work closely with technical and refinement teams to ensure that solutions reflect real-life processes, challenges and user needs. You will also contribute to customer dialogue, where your practical experience helps create credibility and a strong understanding of how the product can support customers in their daily work.

A significant part of the role involves leveraging your property management experience in product improvements, customer insight and relevant market activities. You will participate in customer meetings, support pre-sales activities and contribute to business development through market dialogue and feedback from existing and potential customers. This is not a sales role; your contribution is your professional expertise and ability to understand the customer's operational reality, ask the right questions and help connect their needs with the capabilities of the product.

**Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include

**

• Ensuring the product delivers value, automation potential and efficiency across the property management value chain

• Working closely with the technical team and refinement team on product development

• Supporting business development and sales activities through market dialogue, customer feedback and pre-sales activities

• Participating in customer meetings and other client-facing activities

• Building trust and credibility in customer dialogues

**About You

**To succeed in this role, you:

• Have solid operational experience working as a property manager

• Contribute with operational experience across a property portfolio, including the full complexity of Danish regulatory requirements (eg. cost control rent 'OMK', free market rent, taxes, duties and rates, operational budgets)

• Have experience across residential, commercial and mixed properties including the customer reporting requirements a property manager faces

• Have experience as a power user or super user of a property management software system

• Have full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

**Join an inclusive community

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

**Send us an application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Are you a people-focused leader who enjoys creating structure, solving challenges, and improving the way things work? Do you thrive on building a strong team spirit and helping people perform at their best?

If so, you may be our new Quality Team Leader at NORMAL’s warehouse in Hedensted.

**About The Role

**As Quality Team Leader, you will lead and support the Quality Team across both day and evening shifts. Your leadership skills, ability to motivate others, and focus on continuous improvement will be key to your success.

You will set a clear direction for the team, develop employees, improve processes, and ensure smooth communication between shifts and departments. You will also work closely with colleagues and stakeholders across the organization to maintain and improve the quality standards delivered to our stores and warehouse.

Experience from logistics or warehousing is an advantage, but it is not essential. What matters most is your ability to lead, communicate clearly, and bring out the best in people.

At NORMAL, we believe in trust, open communication, and teamwork. In this role, you will help create a positive and supportive workplace where people feel valued, take ownership, and are encouraged to do their best every day.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Lead, support, and develop the Quality Team.

• Motivate and develop employees through clear communication, coaching, feedback, and encouragement.

• Plan daily operations and coordinate staffing and schedules.

• Recruiting the right talent and build a strong team.

• Identify opportunities for improvement and implement practical, effective solutions.

• Ensure a smooth transition and strong communication between day and evening shift.

• Collaborate with warehouse departments to ensure efficient and seamless operations.

• Maintain an ongoing dialogue with internal and external stakeholders about quality standards we deliver to our stores and improvement opportunities.

• Follow up on quality performance, safety, and compliance with company standards.

• Lead by example and step in to support the team when needed.

• Report to the Planning & Quality Manager.

**About You

**You are motivated by seeing your team succeed and believe that a strong team spirit leads to great results. You are approachable, organized, and structured in your way of working, while also being willing to roll up your sleeves and help when needed.

You remain calm and focused when things get busy, communicate clearly, and know how to keep people engaged. You bring a proactive, positive, and people-focused attitude to your work – and you genuinely care about your team and the results you achieve together.

**We Expect That You

**

• Have experience leading a team, preferably within warehousing or logistics.

• Communicate confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Are flexible and able to support the team across both day and evening shifts.

• Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

**It Is An Advantage If You

**

• Have experience working with a Warehouse Management System or similar tools.

• Have experience working with ERP-systems.

• Are familiar with SQL or other database structures.

**Why join NORMAL A/S?

****At NORMAL, You Will Get

**

• The opportunity to make a real impact on our growing operations.

• A down-to-earth workplace where people work together and ideas are heard.

• A role with responsibility, variety, and influence.

• Opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career.

• The chance to lead a committed team and help create a positive working environment.

If you enjoy leading by example, creating positive energy, and achieving great results through people, we would love to hear from you.

**Location and working hours

**

• Location: NORMAL’s warehouse in Hedensted

• Employment: Full-time, 37 hours per week

• Working hours: A balanced schedule supporting both:

• Day shift: 07:00–15:00

• Evening shift: 15:00–23:00

**Ready to Apply?

**We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your application as soon as possible. The position will remain open until we have found the right candidate.

**Questions?

**If you have any questions about the position, please contact:

**Kirsten Marie Ravn

**Planning & Quality Manager

kira@normal.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Account Executive, SMB (Remote)

**About TrackSights & Your Role

**Every day, thousands of used cars change hands between traders, dealer groups and leasing companies across Europe, and most of those decisions are still made on gut feeling, spreadsheets and phone calls. TrackSights changes that. We turn live market, VIN, government, proprietary and other data into instant, trusted answers on what a car is worth, where it sells fastest and what it will return, so B2B traders, sourcing departments and remarketing teams can price, source and sell with confidence. And with every user we welcome, we're steadily building a network of trusted professional B2B players across Europe's automotive trade, a network our product roadmap is designed to bring closer together.

We started in 2025 and are already used across Europe, backed by Maki.vc and Cox Automotive, one of the world's largest automotive services companies. The product works, users stay and renew, and the sales playbook is proven: the founders have closed every deal themselves. That's exactly the problem worth having. Inbound is arriving, we're welcoming new users from all over Europe, and the founders can't be the whole sales team anymore.

So we're building one. This is the moment where TrackSights goes from founder-led sales to a commercial organisation, and from a Nordic start to the trusted data and insights partner for the used-car trade across Europe. You'd be joining at the start of that, taking over outbound and helping turn traction into real growth.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Originate & own deals end-to-end: prospecting, demo, negotiation, close, handover to Customer Success

• Handle SME sales to traders, sourcing and remarketing teams across our ICP in Europe, with no single-country focus, but a strong ICP focus

• Book your own meetings through consistent outbound: phone, LinkedIn, email, sequences in HubSpot and other relevant channels

• Build and manage your own pipeline; your numbers are shared with the team weekly/monthly

• Work with the founders on messaging, ICP and how we sell, and help improve the playbook

• Work closely with our two commercial founders and our Director of Customer Success

**You – You’re a Good Match If

**You're a self-starter and entrepreneurial go-getter who's motivated by growing sales while getting your hands dirty and owning your targets. We're building an organisation of good, kind, smart and ambitious people, with low ego, high ambitions and a can-do attitude.

Relentlessly driven to close. High outbound activity and a constant push to move deals to signature. This is our number one criterion.

• Relentlessly driven on outbound. No one hands you leads here. You build your own pipeline from week one, because without the hard outbound work there are no deals to close.

• Hungry for growth. You want to help build a company with international ambitions, and to grow your own responsibility within TrackSights as you deliver.

• Either 2–4 years in B2B or SaaS sales where you generated your own pipeline (not relying on inbound or SDRs), or a strong network and experience in the automotive B2B field plus sales experience

• A track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets

• Driven to originate your own meetings, not waiting for inbound or SDRs to book them for you

• Builder mindset: you've written your own messaging or sequences before, you test and improve how you sell, and you're comfortable when not everything is defined

• CRM discipline: HubSpot preferred; structured in follow-ups, notes and pipeline, and you use the data to improve

• High ownership and consistency: you don't wait for direction, and you do the work

• You’re ambitious and want your commercial responsibility within TrackSights to grow over time, and take on larger projects or lead a team

**Languages

**

• English (required) and preferably, but not necessarily, Danish: full professional proficiency or native

• Danish, German or Dutch: a strong plus

**Your first 90 days

**

• Days 1–30: learn and get in the game already. Get up to speed on the product, the industry, the ICPs and the sales playbook. Shadow the founders on customer calls and start contributing with outreach and building your own network, already from week one.

• Days 31–60: build pipeline. You’ve already got several meetings in the books and held several. Run your own outbound, book your own meetings, run calls and demos end to end, find your rhythm in HubSpot, and maybe close your first customer. This is ultimately how you learn.

• Days 61–90: own it. Own your pipeline from first touch to close. Your first customers start to close, and you start contributing to how we scale sales.

Clear expectations for activity and results are agreed in writing before you start, and reviewed together every week.

**Why join

**

• Join an amazing team full of good people

• Join a truly exciting growth and international journey together with ambitious people, where only you set the limits

• Real ownership and impact in a company that's building its commercial organisation now

• Work directly with founders who closed current customers and proved the playbook

• Shape how sales is done, rather than executing someone else's playbook

• Where it can go: larger accounts, new markets, strategic responsibility, and in time a leading role with people under you, if you’re up to it. An option, not a requirement

**Compensation And How We Work

**

• Competitive base salary and an uncapped, attractive commission structure, with real upside tied to performance

• Warrant programme, so it feels like your company too

• Fully remote, with the option of an office (to be agreed)

• Danish holiday standards, team offsites (the last one was in Croatia!) and other perks

• High ownership, low bureaucracy, and a strong focus on culture and team fit (we only hire good-hearted people)

**Interested?

**Send us your CV and a short voice note on why this role and TrackSights make sense for you.

We will consider applicants and hire on an ongoing basis, and conduct a structured 3–4-step interview process.

**Your impact begins here

**As Training Partner, you will build the training setup for the future 25L organisation while it is still taking shape. You will identify training needs, partner with leaders and turn business challenges into practical learning that gets people ready for their roles. Your work will support onboarding and capability building as 25L moves towards the PV phase in early 2028 and running production.

**What You’ll Bring

**You bring a strong learning mindset and the ability to translate business needs into practical, impactful training.

• A relevant degree within learning science, psychology, human resources or similar – or experience from a production environment combined with a passion for learning.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience developing training and learning activities.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholders.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership and proactively drive improvements.

• A solid quality mindset and fluent English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience developing training in a structured or regulated environment.

**What You’ll Do

**You will act as an advisor and operational partner to the business, making sure training is effective, compliant and supports performance and continuous improvement.

• Identify training needs and build the future training structure for 25L, including finalising training need analyses (TNAs) with key stakeholders.

• Act as a trusted partner to leaders, showing how training can address business challenges and support onboarding and capability building.

• Design, develop, implement and evaluate training content with stakeholders across day-to-day operations and projects.

• Deliver training on training standards, including train-the-trainer, and help develop high-quality Training Outlines (TROLs) and Job Instructions (JIs).

• Support continuous improvement and systematic problem solving together with colleagues across the organisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the 25L Training team in Hillerød, Denmark, where training excellence and continuous improvement are at the core. It is a small team, so you will collaborate closely and support one another in your day-to-day work.

Your closest partners will be leaders, content responsibles and your training colleagues. Together, you will make sure onboarding is effective, capability grows and the training setup can support the business as 25L moves from project phase to running production. Right now, the main focus is finalising TNAs with key stakeholders and building the training setup for the future organisation.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work close to the business, where your expertise is valued and your ownership makes a visible difference. You will be trusted to take initiative and drive improvements, and supported by a team that helps each other perform. As part of a global healthcare company, you will have opportunities to learn and develop as 25L grows.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 499,600 to DKK 734,400, corresponding to the level of the position. Placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on your skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build the training that prepares 25L for what comes next, apply for the Training Partner 25L role by 15 November2026.

For further information about the position, please contact Sr. Manager Steven B. Rødkær, SVVR@novonordisk.com.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Analyst in Capital Planning – Help Shape the Bank’s Financial Future
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**_Capital planning sits at the heart of how Danske Bank balances financial resilience with sustainable growth. As part of a close-knit analytical team, you will contribute to decisions that enable the bank to serve its customers and support its strategic ambitions. This is a role where your work genuinely matters and where you will build a solid foundation in capital management.

_**What You Will Be Doing

**The Capital Planning team is part of Financial Resource Management in Group Treasury, sitting within Danske Bank's CFO area. The team of seven works on capital target setting, capital issuances, dividend decisions and macroeconomic stress testing. Your analyses and reports will receive close attention from the Executive Leadership Team, the Board of Directors and financial regulators. The atmosphere is collaborative, with knowledge sharing and learning woven into everyday working life, and the team takes pride in delivering high-quality work while enjoying the process.

More specifically, you will:

• Support monthly capital and MREL assessments and projections

• Analyse the effects of regulatory and model changes with relevant teams

• Contribute to stress tests and assessments of capital targets and buffers

• Help analyse payout capacity and capital and MREL funding needs

• Prepare decision material and gradually take ownership of defined deliverables

**About You

**

• Master's degree in economics, finance, business administration or a related field

• Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented approach

• Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in English

• Curious and collaborative, with an interest in learning and developing within the field

• Comfortable working independently on defined tasks while contributing to team goals

Experience in banking or capital management, and familiarity with Python, SQL or similar tools, would be a welcome addition. We consider candidates at different stages of their career, so we encourage you to apply whether you are just starting out or bring a few years of relevant experience.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We work in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to hiring manager Henrik Bang at hban@danskebank.dk if you have any questions about the role before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 22 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Join Our Team

**We are looking for an experienced and engaging Manager, Compliance to lead a diverse and highly competent team supporting critical compliance and validation activities across the site Engineering at BNK site.

This is an excellent opportunity for a leader who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys working across multiple disciplines and stakeholder groups. In this role, you will be responsible for developing both people and processes while ensuring high levels of quality, compliance, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of specialists with diverse academic backgrounds and areas of expertise.

• Ensure the timely execution of compliance activities across the BNK site.

• Support the planning, execution, and lifecycle management of validation activities, including equipment, systems, processes, and periodic reviews.

• Drive compliance initiatives and ensure adherence to GMP requirements and internal quality standards.

• Oversee and support Change Requests, Deviations, CAPAs, risk assessments, and other quality system processes.

• Collaborate closely with Production, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and other stakeholders.

• Identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies.

• Build and maintain a strong culture of quality, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Manage team resources, priorities, and competencies to ensure successful delivery of departmental objectives.

**About The Team

**The Compliance team consists of dedicated professionals with a broad range of academic backgrounds and technical expertise. The team supports a variety of activities related to validation, compliance, quality systems, and regulatory requirements, playing a key role in ensuring that BNK operates in accordance with internal standards and external regulations.

The department is known for its collaborative culture, strong knowledge sharing, and close partnerships across the organization.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Quality Management, or a related field.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably within a GMP-regulated environment.

• Solid understanding of compliance, validation, and quality management systems.

• Experience with Change Control, Deviations, CAPAs, risk management, and continuous improvement activities.

• Experience of internal and external Regulatory audits is an important pre-requisite

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to lead teams with diverse educational and professional backgrounds.

• Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to leadership.

**Language Requirements

**As the role requires close collaboration with both local and global stakeholders, fluency in English is required.

**What We Offer

**

• A leadership role with significant impact on quality, compliance, and business performance.

• The opportunity to lead a highly skilled and diverse team of specialists.

• A collaborative and supportive working environment with a wide range of stakeholders.

• Professional and personal development opportunities within a growing organization.

• The chance to contribute to continuous improvement and compliance excellence across the BNK site.

If you are passionate about people leadership, quality, and driving a strong compliance culture, we look forward to hearing from you.

**Salary Package

**Annual base salary range: DKK 738.810 –902.990 gross

Flexible working conditions, pension scheme, health insurance, competitive compensation package and potential bonus opportunities.

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The final base salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and competencies, as well as internal pay equity.

**Ready to help keep life-saving vaccines moving?

**Apply through our designated application platform. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Launch Manager for global launch projects
jobs.description:
Would you like to help orchestrate the global launch of new products, representing our supply chain throughout the entire launch projects?

Join a global group of skilled supply chain professionals and follow new products from early development all the way to market – as your input will ensure that we deliver the best products to people with intimate healthcare needs.

“We play a key part in planning and executing successful launches – and we are a valued voice in the process, allowing us to set a clear direction,” explains Head of Supply Chain Launch, Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen.

Join Our Highly Experienced Launch Department

Together, we are 7 colleagues, responsible for supply chain activities related to bringing new and innovative products to market within Chronic Care and Wound Care products. A good part of our time, we spend working with our factories in Hungary, Costa Rica, and soon Portugal.

“As we are each dedicated to different projects, discussing what we’ve learned with each other is very important to us. And we’ll be there to make sure you get to ease into the position,” says Daniel.

Ensure that supply chain is covered in every project

As part of the Coloplast global supply chain, you will find yourself in the middle of a web of stakeholders working towards launching new Chronic Care and Wound Care products. Here, you will be dedicated to specific projects, acting as supply chain lead or subject matter expert, representing the voice of supply chain and making sure supply chain is on track for launch.

Specifically, you will be the subject matter expert from supply chain, staying up to date on project progression. Moreover, you will plan the launch and make sure that systems, manufacturing, stock levels, etc. are ready for launch. And when you meet a bump in the road, you will figure out solutions with the project team.

From early project development until post-launch, you will:

• Influence project decisions and direction early, to avoid supply chain risks

• Drive the supply chain plan with manufacturing sites, balancing project deliverables and commercial considerations to launch on time

• Produce launch scenarios in collaboration with other departments and ensure alignment with the rest of the organization

• Coordinate activities at our production sites and flag supply chain risks
